title: Tony Tacheny Drops 'Prologue' Music Video With Bold Artistic Vision
text:
By: Michael Jacobs — Senior Editor | Gay Music News
LAS VEGAS — (March 25, 2026) — Alternative music artist Tony Tacheny returns with his latest visual release, Prologue, a new music video that delivers a bold and artistic exploration of identity and duality.
Released March 4 via Perennial Records as part of his Prologue album, the track blends atmospheric alternative sounds with a visually expressive concept that reflects the artist’s creative vision.

Directed and edited by Tony Tacheny himself, the video embraces a symbolic narrative. As the artist describes it, “the concept is basically there are two wolves inside of me,” offering a layered interpretation of inner conflict and self-expression.
As an openly gay artist, Tacheny continues to build a distinctive presence within the LGBTQ music space, combining introspective themes with visually driven storytelling that resonates with a growing audience.
Watch Tony Tacheny – Prologue Music Video Below:
As Prologue continues to gain traction, Tony Tacheny’s latest release positions him as an artist to watch within the alternative and LGBTQ music space. With its blend of introspective storytelling and visually driven direction, the project reflects a growing trend of independent artists using music videos as a platform for deeper creative expression. JRL CHARTS will continue to follow Tacheny’s next moves as his audience expands across streaming and digital platforms.
